cards.title: The biggest IPO ever
cards.sub: S-1 public Oct 26 · ticker ANT on Nasdaq · price range still blank

hero.label: target raise — the biggest IPO on record

takeaways: Goldman Sachs & Morgan Stanley lead; JPMorgan also on ticket
Proceeds earmarked mostly for next-gen model training (est.)
5% of equity pre-pledged to the Public Benefit Fund

cards.title: One share beats everyone
cards.sub: Founders keep 50.1% of votes — Amazon and Google are capped

hero.label: voting power via a single Class F share

items.title: Founder LLC · Class F
items.desc: 7 co-founders, one share, elects 3 board seats

items.title: Long-Term Benefit Trust · Class T
items.desc: Bernanke sits on it; elects and removes the board majority

items.title: Public · Class A
items.desc: 1 vote per share, capped at 49.9% of total votes

items.sub: cap 14.99%; option for $10B more at IPO price

takeaways: No VC holds 5%+ — Spark and Iconiq are the largest funds
Trust removable only by 85% of common shareholders
Buying ANT means funding the mission, not steering it

cards.title: It sells intelligence by the token
cards.sub: Not a chat-app company — pay-as-you-go API is the engine

items.sub: Mythos · Opus · Sonnet · Haiku, priced per token

takeaways: New models drive the money — latest versions = 80% of recent-quarter revenue
47% of 2025 revenue flowed through Amazon & Google cloud channels
Two unnamed customers were ~12% each in 2025

cards.title: Fastest ramp in software history
cards.sub: Revenue ×396 in three years — and Q2 turned operationally profitable
takeaways: The filing itself warns growth may reflect early adoption

cards.title: Priced for perfection
cards.sub: Every dollar of profit has to outrun a $518B compute bill

blocks.title: Three risks to watch
items: Compute lock-in — $518B+ committed: Broadcom $161B, SpaceX $120B, Google $114B, AWS $110B
Concentration — top 5 customers ~25% of revenue; cloud channel 47% of 2025 sales
Deceleration — QoQ growth cooling to ~45–50% while GAAP losses widen

items.sub: at listing — the record to beat

takeaways: No meaningful PE — the profit track record is one quarter old
Blank price range: watch the amended S-1 around Nov 9
Investors are underwriting the build-out, not the earnings
